newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: U.S. First Lady starts four-day visit to Portugal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. First Lady starts four-day visit to Portugal.

text.p: Hillary Rodham Clinton arrived on Wednesday for a four-day visit to Portugal, the first such trip by the wife of a serving U.S. president.
The U.S. First Lady is accompanied by her daughter Chelsea for the visit, which will include some official engagements as well as sight-seeing.
Clinton will give a speech on infant education at Lisbon's Gulbenkian Foundation on Thursday and visit the Roman Catholic shrine of Fatima, 120 km (75 miles) north of Lisbon, on Friday.
